home.title: Migration Document Manager
home.subtitle: Prepare your ClinicCloud migration files in three simple steps: browse your documents, apply naming conventions, and bundle them into a delivery package.
home.step1.title: List your documents
home.step1.description: Open the input folder and see every file available. Filter by name or extension. Confirm the documents are the ones you need before doing anything else.
home.step2.title: Rename if needed
home.step2.description: Apply a consistent naming convention across one or many files at once. Preview the new names before saving — nothing changes until you confirm.
home.step3.title: Build the package
home.step3.description: Select the documents you want to deliver and generate a ZIP. A manifest file is included automatically so the recipient knows exactly what's inside.
home.card1.title: List Documents
home.card1.description: Browse all files in your configured input folder. Filter by name or extension, check sizes and dates, and confirm you have everything you need before proceeding.
home.card1.feature3: Sort by name, date or size
home.card2.title: Rename Documents
home.card2.description: Apply a consistent naming convention to one or many documents at once. Always preview the new names before confirming — nothing is changed until you approve.
home.card2.feature1: Rename one or many at once
home.card3.title: Package Documents
home.card3.description: Select the documents you want to deliver and generate a ZIP package ready to send. A manifest file is included automatically with the full list of contents.
home.tip.label: Recommended order:
home.tip.end: to generate your delivery ZIP. You can always skip steps that are not needed.
listing.title: List Documents
listing.description: Enter the folder path where your migration documents are stored. All files inside, including those in subfolders, will be listed.
listing.table.name: File name
listing.empty.title: No documents found
listing.empty.description: The folder exists but contains no files. Make sure your migration documents are inside this folder.
listing.initial.title: Enter a folder path to get started
listing.initial.description: Type or paste the full path to your documents folder above and click Browse.
